subject: System Design
title: Servers and Clients
description: A quick win: understand Servers and Clients.

hook.text: Every time you use an app, your device is the client and a remote machine is the server.

buildup.text: Clients request data. Servers process requests and send responses. This is client-server architecture.

discovery.text: A single server can handle thousands of clients simultaneously using connection multiplexing.

twist.text: Modern apps blur the line. Peer-to-peer systems like BitTorrent make every device both client and server.

climax.text: Client-server is the foundation of nearly every internet service, from email to streaming.

punchline.text: One asks, one answers — the web's oldest pattern.

quiz.question: What does a server do in client-server architecture?
